Answer emission uses a generated route-profile runtime index, emits claim-level provenance and decision-adapter checks, and requires adapter execution evidence from registered producers; local model evidence must now be backed by explicit model-input bundles rather than adapter shape alone.
answer_disposition_runtime_note: Runtime emits profile-backed answer packets, source-backed claims, precedence order, final disposition, decision adapters, strict evidence execution, replay ledgers, decision-promotion gates, and promotion-gated decision-output packets; implementation remains fail-closed because no trusted external-attestation verifier is configured, and perishable law/model/no-go facts still require external evidence producers.
